input.free_text_description: This system is a authentication platform that serves User, Content Creator roles. It manages core business objects including product, user role, user. The platform provides capabilities for token, authorization. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include distributed transactions functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage product records, so that I can track and organize product data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user role records, so that I can track and organize user role data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a User, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
